title: Alucard
synopsis: A gothic dark-fantasy saga unfolds in a world of vampires, ancient bloodlines, and supernatural forces. As darkness spreads, a series of encounters reveals the terrifying secrets of a world where death is only the beginning.

audienceReactions.quote: Gave off some vampire hunter D vibes. Nice job!
